source.title: Volvo Truck Corporation, Design and function D13A, Service Bulletin 200 281 01, February 2006
source.access: HTML text on third-party mirror; figures not inspected or copied

assets.scope: Forged steel piston, oil cooling, two compression rings and sprung scraper ring, replaceable cast-iron liner, forged connecting rod.
Overhead camshaft, three cams per cylinder, twin inlet and exhaust valves, floating bridges and central unit injector. Schematic unfolded view, VEB special profiles excluded.
Rear timing gear drive, crankshaft, double and adjustable idlers, camshaft, ancillary branches and optional PTO. Branch group not precise gear mesh.

limitations: No OEM drawings copied; conceptual diagrams not dimensions, repair instructions or actual assembly topology; variant and physical photos required before expert acceptance.
